edges.reason: fallback() forwards execution to _fallback().
receive() forwards execution to _fallback().
_fallback invokes the _willFallback hook before delegating.
_fallback delegates execution through _delegate.
_fallback resolves the implementation address via _implementation.
_fallback inspects msg.sender with OpenZeppelinUpgradesAddress.isContract.
msg.sender is read in the fallback gate controlling ETH-receive behavior.
_delegate performs delegatecall, handing control to the implementation contract.
The delegatecall executes arbitrary implementation code that can re-enter the fallback path.
_implementation reads storage via the sload unsafe operation.
_implementation reads the IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT state variable.
_upgradeTo calls _setImplementation to persist the new address.
_setImplementation validates newImplementation via isContract.
_setImplementation writes the implementation through the sstore unsafe operation.
_setImplementation consumes the newImplementation parameter.
_setImplementation uses IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT as the write target.
admin() returns the result of _admin().
admin() is reachable only through the ifAdmin msg.sender authorization check.
implementation() returns the result of _implementation().
implementation() is guarded by the ifAdmin msg.sender check.
changeAdmin calls _setAdmin to persist the new administrator.
changeAdmin is guarded by the ifAdmin msg.sender check.

upgradeTo calls _upgradeTo.
upgradeTo is guarded by the ifAdmin msg.sender check.
upgradeTo consumes the newImplementation parameter.
upgradeToAndCall calls _upgradeTo before the delegatecall.

The arbitrary delegatecall target can re-enter the proxy during upgradeToAndCall.
upgradeToAndCall consumes the newImplementation parameter.
upgradeToAndCall is guarded by the ifAdmin msg.sender check.
upgradeToAndCall forwards the data calldata parameter into the delegatecall.
_admin reads the ADMIN_SLOT state variable.
_setAdmin writes to the ADMIN_SLOT state variable.
_setAdmin writes the admin through the sstore unsafe operation.
_setAdmin consumes the newAdmin parameter.
_willFallback requires msg.sender != _admin() before delegating.
_willFallback calls _admin() to perform the authorization check.

isContract uses the extcodesize unsafe operation.

_delegate consumes the implementation parameter as delegatecall target.

normalization_plan.reason: The implementation parameter only feeds the delegatecall target inside _delegate and has no standalone semantic identity.
newImplementation is validated and persisted by _setImplementation, which defines its meaning.
newAdmin is only meaningful as the value stored by _setAdmin into ADMIN_SLOT.
The data parameter exists solely to be forwarded as msg.data in the delegatecall made by upgradeToAndCall.
_logic is the initial implementation address consumed by the constructor before being persisted.
_data is the initialization calldata delegatecalled by the constructor.
_admin is the administrator address persisted by the constructor.
account is only inspected by extcodesize inside isContract.
impl is the temporary result of the sload performed by _implementation.
adm is the temporary result of the sload performed by _admin.
The slot alias is a pure assembly convenience for the storage slot used by the setter.
size is the temporary extcodesize result evaluated by isContract.
success is the delegatecall return flag checked with require inside upgradeToAndCall.
